design: Retrospective method development after individual review; no independent accuracy claim.
scope: All 100 attachment-1 samples; no emotion labels or external emotion data used.

face.route: Keep existing frame features; on previously missing frames use YuNet ROI then MediaPipe
face.primary_output: 52 expression coefficients; ROI pose matrices excluded to avoid mixing camera coordinate estimates
face.selection: largest valid proposal first; no active speaker identity claim

text.method: Span-preserving cardinal number equivalence, weighted semiglobal edit distance
text.word_time_masks: unchanged; equivalent numeric groups do not create per-word timestamps
text.controls: Reuse all fixed original/same-video/cross-video pairs from rigor audit

acceptance.face_accuracy: unavailable without independently checked frame boxes
